Redoubt [P]: when a Shield-buffed ally is attacked, reflect 25% of the shield-absorbed damage to the attacker and heal that ally 25% of it. No reflect/redirect op is implemented and there is no 'ally attacked while under Shield' trigger event.

notes: Source of truth: step2-champions.json "Underpriest Brogni" (Legendary/Magic/Support/Dwarves; base HP 22965, ATK 782, DEF 1266, SPD 100, RES 90, ACC 0, C.RATE 0.15, C.DMG 0.5). recipeKey = first word of name = UNDERPRIEST (keys UNDERPRIEST-A1/A2/A3/PASSIVE), matching how UUGO/FAHRAKIN/HILVI derive theirs. Damage formulas taken verbatim from DB multiplier fields (A1 6.5 ATK x1, A2 6.6 ATK x1). A3's DB multiplier '0.3' multiplierType 'HP' is the SHIELD value (30% of MAX HP), NOT an attack — A3 deals no damage, so no A3 formula. Passive's '0.25 (Shield reflection)' is the reflect ratio, not an attack. All clauses accounted: A1 = 2 (attack + HP Burn, both modelled); A2 = 4 clauses (attack + buff-strip + cleanse modelled, shield-boost deferred); A3 = 3 clauses (Increase ATK + Shield modelled, Block Debuffs deferred inert; 'cannot be removed' noted); Passive = 1 reactive mechanic deferred (+ single-copy note). HP Burn kept as MAX-HP-scaling, DEF-independent DoT (no DEF-shred credit). Removals handled as BUFF_STRIP (enemy buffs) and CLEANSE (ally debuffs) per strip-not-place / cleanse rules, not placements. File to paste into: lib/sim/recipes.js (formulas block near F_UUGO_* ; recipe objects near UUGO-*).

Thor A3 permanently decreases enemy RES by 10% (stacks to 50%). Decrease RES is not in the consumer registry (no res in STAT_MODS), so it lands inert; a RES-shred consumer (affects ally debuff land chance) plus a permanent-stacking stat-shred mechanic are both needed.

Thor A4 [Thunder]: increment a self counter each time damage is dealt (cap 10), grant a self DMG% buff per stack, and at the cap fire a threshold AoE attack + [Stun] then reset. Needs a 'damage_dealt' trigger event, a stacking counter with threshold action, and a DMG% self-buff consumer.

notes: Thor (Legendary, Magic, Attack, Barbarians). Base ATK 1553. All three active damage skills scale off ATK (DB multiplier_type). A4 has null multiplier — no formula fabricated. Consumer-registry check: A3 self [Increase ATK] is consumed (kept); self [Increase C.DMG], the permanent Decrease RES, and the A4 DMG% ramp are all inert (deferred). Modelled ops: DEAL_DAMAGE (A1/A2/A3), REDUCE_TURN_METER (A1), PLACE_BUFF Increase ATK (A3), PLACE_DEBUFF Decrease Speed (A3). A3 buff placed at skill_start (card says 'Before attacking') so Increase ATK boosts the same hit. A2 ignore_block_damage is honoured by the interpreter; ignore_unkillable is set but currently registered-not-honoured (○). Every clause of all 4 skills is accounted for as an action or a deferred entry.

notes: Morag Bronzelock — Epic / Spirit / Dwarves / Defense. base ATK 804, DEF 1288 (DEF > ATK, but multiplierType is null on every skill so scaling is NOT fabricated — all three formulas carry multiplier:null and default scalingStat:'ATK'; no damage is computed until real multipliers are captured, per the CRITICAL RULE). A2: AoE attack + 25% [Strengthen] all allies 2t (real consumer). A3: Morag + 2 random allies pile on one enemy (ALLY_ATTACK models only ONE joiner — op limitation flagged) + EXTRA_TURN on kill (op is implemented:true; wired with onKill:true rather than deferred). A4 [P]: on-attacked COUNTERATTACK re-running A1, gated on self-[Strengthen] (attacked trigger already used by Ezio P2; the self-buff gate + placed-by-self provenance are the uncertain parts, flagged in deferred + newOpsNeeded). No Poison/HP-Burn/Decrease-DEF here, so no DEF-independence concerns. Two newOps flagged: ALLY_ATTACK multi-random-ally count, and a self-buff-presence/provenance trigger gate.

notes:
Deacon Armstrong (Epic / Spirit / Sacred Order / Support). recipeKey prefix DEACON; recipe keys DEACON-A1/A2/A3. Canonical champion name 'Deacon Armstrong'. Every clause of all 3 skills maps to an implemented op — no deferred-for-missing-op items, newOpsNeeded empty.

When pasted into recipes.js FORMULAS, both take flags: { ...DMG_FLAGS } (shown as string 'DMG_FLAGS' here). Each recipe object should also carry champion:'Deacon Armstrong' inline when pasted into recipes.js (omitted here because the output schema forbids extra props).

A1 [Leech] and A2 [Decrease DEF] are both Consumer Registry effects (Leech → team heal off the leeched enemy; Decrease Defense → statFactor DEF shred), so both are real PLACE_DEBUFF actions, not inert. Used type 'Decrease Defense' (engine STAT_MODS accepts both 'Decrease Defense' and 'Decrease DEF'; matches Hilvi-A1).

A3 implementation detail: the interpreter's REDUCE_TURN_METER handler operates on ctx.intended (the acquired set), NOT act.target — so ACQUIRE_TARGETS all_enemies (seq 10) is REQUIRED before the -15% enemy TM decrease. FILL_TURN_METER reads act.target ('all_allies') directly and needs no acquire. EXTRA_TURN is unconditional (no onKill). accuracy_check:true on the enemy TM decrease mirrors the auto-parser's turnMeterEnemy handling.

notes:
Duchess Lilitu (Legendary / Spirit / Demonspawn / Support) — pure sustain/support enabler; only A1 deals damage.

FORMULAS: F_DUCHESS_A1 scales off DEF (multiplierType=DEF, DB multiplier 1.7, "Attacks 1 enemy 2 times" -> hitCount 2). Target DEF-shred still boosts these (ATK/DEF-vs-DEF attack). A2/A3 have null DB multiplier and place no damage, so no DEAL_DAMAGE for them — nothing fabricated.

A1: 3 accounted clauses — 2-hit attack; [Shield]=10% caster MAX HP 2t split into TWO PLACE_BUFF actions (self + lowest_hp_ally) since the card places on both and there is no combined self+lowest recipient enum. Shield IS in the consumer registry (pctOfCasterMaxHp shape matches Bad-el/Rae A2 recipes).

A2: 3 accounted clauses — [Increase ATK] 50% and [Perfect Veil] both modelled (both in registry; Perfect Veil on all_allies_except_self makes dealers untargetable-by-single, mirroring MAVARA-A3). [Block Debuffs] DEFERRED as inert (not in CONSUMED_EFFECTS).

A3: 3 accounted clauses — REVIVE all_dead_allies at 70% HP (hpPct 0.70; no TM clause on the card so no tmPct); [Veil] 1t on all_allies_except_self (Veil in registry); 15% [Continuous Heal] on all allies (in registry). All modelled.

PASSIVE: static AoE damage-reduction aura -> 1 deferred clause + 1 newOpsNeeded. Not a reactive trigger (no on-hit/on-death event) — an always-on incoming-damage multiplier — so no triggers[] block.

Verification: every clause of all 4 skills lands in actions or deferred (A1 3/3, A2 3/3 with 1 inert-deferred, A3 3/3, Passive 1 deferred). No orphan clauses. Every PLACE_BUFF effect (Shield, Increase ATK, Perfect Veil, Veil, Continuous Heal) is in the consumer registry. No fabricated multipliers. recipeKey=DUCHESS (first word of name).

PASTE NOTE: formulas[].flags is the literal spread "{ ...DMG_FLAGS }" to match existing F_* entries; when pasted into recipes.js it is the object spread, not a string.

notes: Lord Entertainer Fabian (Legendary / Spirit / Support / Undead Hordes) is a pure CC/control champion — ALL FOUR skills have multiplier=null AND multiplierType=null in the DB, so there are ZERO damage formulas and no DEAL_DAMAGE actions (nothing to fabricate); each attacking clause is recorded as a deferred 'damage multiplier not in DB'. recipeKey=LORD because champKey('Lord Entertainer Fabian') = first word uppercased = 'LORD' (same convention as Underpriest Brogni -> UNDERPRIEST), which is what recipeFor() looks up. Fear/True Fear/Petrification are all valid CC consumers (turn-denial), so the placements are modelled, not inert. A1 uses the existing condition:{kind:'tm_depleted'} for its 'if TM fully depleted' True Fear. A2 places True Fear on all_enemies via a mid-skill re-ACQUIRE (ACQUIRE_TARGETS resets ctx.intended and PLACE_DEBUFF reads ctx.intended); the 'other enemies only' + 'not already feared' refinements are deferred (no other_enemies enum, no compound not-under-debuff condition). A3's buff removal is REDUCE_EFFECT_DURATION turns:3 (strip-by-duration) + INCREASE_COOLDOWN. All of Fabian's most distinctive mechanics live in the passive/reactive layer and are unbuildable today: the A2 auto-recast when a feared enemy acts, the passive True-Fear-on-enemy-revive, and his own start-of-turn hard-CC self-cleanse — 3 of the 5 newOpsNeeded. Cooldowns for A2/A3 are null in the DB and left null rather than fabricated (flagged as a data-capture gap and an over-CC risk).

covers: [Active Effect] decreases the cooldown of one of this Champion's skills by 2 turns when she loses >=30% HP from an enemy skill in a single turn (DECREASE_COOLDOWN self, gated by the new hp_loss_threshold trigger)

newOpsNeeded.why: A3 Outcome Assured 'swaps HP with the target' before attacking — a caster<->enemy HP-fraction exchange. Registered in operations.js as implemented:false; distinct from EQUALIZE_HP (ally-side raise-to-highest). Without it, A3's core equalizer identity (the reason she is 'the Equalizer') is unmodelled.

Passive [Active Effect] fires when this Champion loses >=30% MAX HP from an enemy skill in a single turn (cd 3). No existing trigger event covers a single-turn cumulative HP-loss-fraction threshold — examples only expose attacked, hit_taken, hp_below (a static HP level), start_of_turn, round_start, ally_death, enemy_frozen. hp_below tests a standing HP level, not damage-taken this turn.
Passive [Passive Effect] counterattacks each time an enemy is healed by a skill (once per turn). No enemy-heal event exists in the trigger vocabulary; needed to fire the COUNTERATTACK.

notes:
Magic / Legendary / Attack, Undead Hordes. Base stats hp 14865 atk 1531 def 1057 spd 99 res 30 acc 10 crR 15 crD 63. All 4 skills fully accounted (no orphan clauses).

A1 Violent Harmony (cd0, 1.9 ATK x2): two independent per-hit riders both modelled ON the formula, matching the F_STAG_A1 / F_NINJA_A2 per-hit pattern — selfHealPctOfDamage 0.20 (lifesteal-style, like F_GNUT_A3/F_HORDIN_A2) and onHitPlaceDebuff [Heal Reduction] 100% 2t @50% (Heal Reduction IS in the consumer registry). Nothing deferred.

A2 Precise Intervention (cd4, 3.9 ATK AoE): Leech modelled (consumed); Weaken deferred as inert (not in CONSUMED_EFFECTS). The card places both under one shared 75% roll — modelled as an independent 75% Leech, EV-identical (same convention as FAHRAKIN-A2's shared-roll note).

A3 Outcome Assured (cd5, 2.8 ATK x2): 'removes all debuffs from this Champion' => CLEANSE target self (count 99 = 'all'; engine CLEANSE is untyped so this removes all self debuffs, exactly the intent). Base ignore 15% DEF => flags.ignore_def 0.15 (like F_ALICE_A3 0.2, F_EZIO_A3 0.35). Two A3 clauses deferred: the HP swap (needs SWAP_HP op — her signature mechanic) and the HP-conditional upgrade to 30% ignore + [Shield] ignore (runtime caster-vs-target HP compare that swaps formula flags — not statically expressible; base 15% used).

Passive My True Purpose [P] (cd3): correctly slotted type:'passive' with reactive triggers (NOT an active A-slot — avoids the INERT-CHAMPION mis-slot). Both halves need NEW trigger events (hp_loss_threshold, enemy_healed); the ops they fire (DECREASE_COOLDOWN self, COUNTERATTACK A1) already exist. Counterattack shape mirrors EZIO-PASSIVE2. Once-per-turn cadence flagged oncePerTurn:true; the active effect's cd3 gate via trigger cooldown:3.

Formulas paste into FORMULAS; recipes keyed VALLARYN-A1/A2/A3/PASSIVE. Field shapes copied from FAHRAKIN/UUGO/HILVI/GNUT/EZIO entries.
